name: blender low poly pine tree from primitives
goal: Build a simple low-poly pine tree using cylinder and circle meshes with extrude/scale/duplicate.

source.title: ABSOLUTE Beginner Basics.. Blender For Noobs 2025

prerequisites: Know viewport nav and Edit mode basics

outputs.name: pine_tree_meshes
outputs.description: Trunk + layered foliage circles approximating a pine

constraints: Keep vertex counts low for games (e.g. cylinder ~8 sides, circle ~12)

steps.action: Delete unneeded default mesh if present.
Shift+A → Mesh → Cylinder; in Add Cylinder adjust vertices down (e.g. 8) for low poly.
Tab Edit mode; scale trunk; select top face, move up, S scale for trunk taper; optional Shade Smooth Auto Smooth.
Edit mode, edge select; E then Z to extrude on Z; S scale; Ctrl+R loop cuts and scale for foliage layers.
L select linked pieces as needed; Shift+D duplicate foliage layers; R/S (and R then Z) to vary layers.
Stack scaled/rotated circle extrusions above the trunk for a pine silhouette.

verification: Scene contains trunk cylinder and multiple foliage layers
